findings.fix: Relabel as recorded_origin_label; preserve historical source evidence bytes and selected value; independently repin new dossier.

findings.fix: Include both validated source facts with exact value_json, record SHA/path/pointer, body SHA, official URL, page, locator and observation kind.

combined_profile.command: python -m pytest tests/test_ad30_source_facts.py tests/test_ad30_applicability.py tests/test_ad30_duty_preview.py tests/test_ad30_candidate_cli.py tests/test_ad30_review_redteam.py tests/test_ett_duty_preview.py -q

cli_process_audits.method: Fresh real CLI interpreters with audit hooks rejecting attempted socket, SQLite, subprocess, database-file access, filesystem mutations, or application startup. Bytecode writes disabled; isolated non-SQLite sentinel DB and input/source bytes verified unchanged.

source_binding_review.method: Compared body SHA, URL, recorded capture status, page bounds and record SHA to retained capture/source records, separately from self-consistent dossier hashes. Independently reread all three preserved Decision 12 pages and matched render hashes to prior capture evidence.

boundaries: Missing, malformed, outside or contradictory product candidates yield no amount, not zero liability.
DTO source/rate/approval forgeries are rejected at both product and money boundaries.
Unknown producer never selects the other-producers row automatically.
Printed row arithmetic retains exact sub-cent amounts under hostile ambient Decimal precision.
Dates before, within and after printed historical horizons never establish legal or temporal applicability.
All three hypothetical monetary rows expose complete source-row and unit provenance.

consumer_document_review.method: Compared all result-state, evidence, decimal and CLI exit descriptions to the combined code and independent subprocess outputs; independently searched current API/assistant/classifier paths for AD30 imports and found none.

scope_limits: This accepts the isolated technical review candidate, not current or historical AD30 liability.
Source record integrity does not imply native scanned-text verification, complete amendment inventory, producer identity/succession or nomenclature mapping.
Only already-published preserved evidence and Decision 12 page renders were reused; no new official-source acquisition or full legal audit was performed.
The product evaluator intentionally uses a bounded country-identity set and the documented limited dimensional consistency checks; it is not a general geometry or conformity validator.
A0 must record successful exact assembled and published HEAD CI, frontend/types/build and staging verification before the task is complete.
